creation_publiee_complete_check.name: creation_publiee_complete_check
creation_publiee_complete_check.value: "creation"."statut_publication" = 'BROUILLON' or ("creation"."titre" is not null and "creation"."objectif" is not null and "creation"."categorie_id" is not null and "creation"."date_publication" is not null)

creation_rang_check.name: creation_rang_check
creation_rang_check.value: "creation"."rang_final_participation" is null or "creation"."defi_id" is not null

defi_duree_check.name: defi_duree_check
defi_duree_check.value: "defi"."date_fin" - "defi"."date_debut" between interval '1 day' and interval '30 days'

sujet_astuce_check.name: sujet_astuce_check
sujet_astuce_check.value: "sujet"."type_sujet" <> 'ASTUCE' or ("sujet"."exemple_avant" is not null and "sujet"."exemple_apres" is not null)

sujet_fermeture_check.name: sujet_fermeture_check
sujet_fermeture_check.value: "sujet"."fermeur_id" is null or "sujet"."date_fermeture" is not null

decision_moderation_cible_check.name: decision_moderation_cible_check
decision_moderation_cible_check.value: ("decision_moderation"."action" not in ('AUCUNE', 'MASQUER', 'RETABLIR', 'SUPPRIMER', 'AJOUTER_AVERTISSEMENT_AGENT', 'RETIRER_AVERTISSEMENT_AGENT') or "decision_moderation"."contenu_id" is not null) and ("decision_moderation"."action" not in ('AVERTIR', 'SUSPENDRE', 'BANNIR', 'AJUSTER_REPUTATION', 'RETIRER_BADGE') or "decision_moderation"."membre_vise_id" is not null)

decision_moderation_suspension_check.name: decision_moderation_suspension_check
decision_moderation_suspension_check.value: ("decision_moderation"."action" = 'SUSPENDRE') = ("decision_moderation"."date_fin_suspension" is not null) and ("decision_moderation"."date_fin_suspension" is null or "decision_moderation"."date_fin_suspension" - "decision_moderation"."date" between interval '1 day' and interval '90 days')
